stop_reason: H73-1 re-ran the lane's mandated first test with 15x the statistical power of any prior run (hide_frac 0.50, seeds 20/21/22, 100 orientation-matched control transects per component => n = 4004 scoreable components vs 262 before). The scale-free relative steepness step is +0.0097 [-0.0012, +0.0203] (INCONCLUSIVE, gate not met; median component -0.0449 and only 40.4% positive, so the small positive mean is a tail effect). On the off-catalogue population the board actually scores, the same statistic is significantly NEGATIVE (-0.0851 [-0.0948, -0.0751]). A control statistic containing no step information at all, block-centred log(ksn), scores +0.1946 [0.1695, +0.2195], which explains why the absolute-dksn arm (+0.3560) and every prior 'PROCEED' in this lane (H67-1 +0.4251, H68-1 +0.4502) passed: they carry steepness LEVEL, not steepness STEP. The lane is stopped with a bounded null, not with an unresolved one.
